bull_bear.body:
- Proprietary AI-driven product ecosystem enabling a scalable 'land and expand' model
- Scaled, multi-vertical platform addressing both human-layer (Threatcop) and infrastructure-layer (AutoSecT) cyber risk
- Debt-free balance sheet
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Related-party transaction concentration — The Company transacts with multiple entities in which KMPs or their relatives hold substantial interest (Scalemax Advisors (OPC) Private Limited, Scalemax Ventures LLP, Xrise Ventures LLP, Easenode Tech Private Limited, Yarsha Ventures LLP, Threatcop Inc.), which is a governance/related-party exposure to monitor.
- Rising contingent liabilities from bank guarantees — Contingent liabilities related to bank guarantees rose sharply, from Rs. 234.18 lakh (FY24) and Rs. 273.45 lakh (FY25) to Rs. 3,416.01 lakh (FY26), indicating growing client-contract guarantee exposure.
- Post-IPO dilution of return ratios — Return on Equity Ratio declined -99.617% YoY and Return on Capital Employed declined -63.349% YoY in FY26, both attributed by the Company to the increase in share capital / capital employed following the enlarged equity base.
- On-demand working capital financing — Working capital borrowing is secured against current assets including trade receivables, carries interest at 9.15% per annum, and is repayable on demand, exposing the Company to refinancing/call risk.
- Margin compression — Net Profit Ratio declined -32.760% YoY in FY26, which the Company attributes to sales growth outpacing profit growth.
- Declining debt service coverage — Debt Service Coverage Ratio fell -12.908% YoY in FY26, attributed by the Company to a decrease in profit.

outlook.body:
- Continue to scale the AutoSecT platform
- Deepen US and UAE presence through overseas subsidiaries
- Pursue a 'land and expand' approach
- Invest in R&D and talent to keep pace with the evolving threat landscape
- Retain profits to fund growth initiatives, expansion plans and future business opportunities rather than pay dividends
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: As an asset-light cybersecurity/IT services company, expansion is described in terms of geographic and platform footprint rather than physical capacity: the Company is deepening its US and UAE presence through overseas subsidiaries and continuing to scale its AutoSecT platform, supporting a rise in exports (from 13.05% of revenue in FY24 to 29.94% in FY26, led by the UAE) alongside its 'land and expand' go-to-market approach.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Sustained double-digit growth in the Indian cybersecurity market, estimated to grow from USD 1.98 Bn (CY2019) to USD 13.60 Bn (CY2025E)
- IT-BPM industry revenue growth, estimated to reach USD 283 Bn by FY25E from USD 167 Bn in FY18, a CAGR of ~7.8%
- Regulatory tailwinds from CERT-In, RBI/SEBI CSCRF, DPDP Act 2023, GDPR/HIPAA/PCI DSS driving demand for cybersecurity solutions
- Rising exports supported by new US and UAE subsidiaries
- Proprietary AI-driven product ecosystem enabling a scalable 'land and expand' model
- Margin moderation attributed to strategic investments in US & Middle East expansion
